_doc: The living half of the MOKU-003 page. The card's URL is burned into a chip and can never change, so this page is the only place depth can accumulate: someone who taps the card again next month should find something that was not here today. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. Every number here is on the page above or is arithmetic on numbers that are; nothing here was measured off a built object, because nobody has built one.

entries.en: There are two cut files, and they disagree
entries.body_en: Two programs in this package write the cut file, and they do not draw the same sheet. The export button marks a tab on both sides of every cell and adds the 10 mm ruler. The Python script in tools/ marks one side and no ruler.

entries.en: Nothing in the file allows for the beam
entries.body_en: This page says the file already allows 0.08 mm for the width of the laser beam. Neither program that writes the cut file applies any offset — 0.08 mm is in the written spec only. Cut one hexagon, measure the hole, then set your own offset.
